blocks.text: 把扫描文档变成可靠的文本并不容易。Tesseract 这类经典 OCR 引擎遇到褪色印刷、手写和传真件就会失灵。视觉模型读这类页面读得不错，但有时会写出页面上根本没有的数值。我们用自己写的文字做了八张测试页，这样每个字符都能核对，然后把它们交给 OpenRouter 上的 15 个视觉模型和 Mistral OCR，再加上 Tesseract 跑了一遍。

blocks.text:
import base64
import mimetypes
import os

import requests

API = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions"
HEADERS = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY']}"}
PROMPT = ("Transcribe all of the text in this scanned document, in reading order. "
          "Copy spelling, numbers and punctuation exactly as they appear, even if they "
          "look wrong. Return plain text only, with no Markdown and no commentary.")


def transcribe(path, model="deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash", reasoning={"effort": "none"}):
    mime = mimetypes.guess_type(path)[0] or "image/jpeg"
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        image = f"data:{mime};base64," + base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode()
    body = {
        "model": model,
        "max_tokens": 16000,
        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": [
            {"type": "text", "text": PROMPT},
            {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": image}},
        ]}],
    }
    if reasoning:
        body["reasoning"] = reasoning
    response = requests.post(API, headers=HEADERS, json=body, timeout=300)
    response.raise_for_status()
    data = response.json()
    choice = data["choices"][0]
    if choice["finish_reason"] != "stop":
        raise ValueError(f"finish_reason={choice['finish_reason']}: the transcript is incomplete")
    return choice["message"]["content"], data["usage"]["cost"]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    text, cost = transcribe("receipt.jpg")
    print(text)
    print(f"\n${cost:.5f}")

HARBOR LANE MARKET
1180 Harbor Lane, Unit 4
Portland OR 97209
Tel (503) 555-0148
...
TOTAL 62.86
VISA ****4471 62.86
AUTH 08813C
...

$0.00022

inlines.text: 第 4 步：把 Mistral OCR 当作专用引擎

blocks.text: Mistral OCR 是专门为文档 OCR 训练的模型。在 OpenRouter 上，它以 file-parser 插件中的引擎形式运行，接受 PDF，每 1,000 页收费 $2。插件会在你的模型看到文件之前先做 OCR。它把文本作为文件注释附在响应里返回，所以你指定的模型只需负责回复。把扫描件包进一页的 PDF，再配任意便宜的模型发送即可：

blocks.text:
import base64
import html
import io
import os

import requests
from PIL import Image, ImageSequence

from transcribe import API, HEADERS  # from step 1


def mistral_ocr(path):
    if path.lower().endswith(".pdf"):  # scanned PDFs go as they are
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            raw = f.read()
    else:  # wrap an image in a PDF in memory, one page per frame of a multipage TIFF
        pages = [p.convert("RGB") for p in ImageSequence.Iterator(Image.open(path))]
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        pages[0].save(buf, "PDF", save_all=True, append_images=pages[1:])
        raw = buf.getvalue()
    pdf = "data:application/pdf;base64," + base64.b64encode(raw).decode()
    pdf_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(path))[0] + ".pdf"
    body = {
        "model": "upstage/solar-mini4",  # any cheap text model; it only has to reply
        "max_tokens": 5,
        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": [
            {"type": "text", "text": "Reply OK."},
            {"type": "file", "file": {"filename": pdf_name, "file_data": pdf}},
        ]}],
        "plugins": [{"id": "file-parser", "pdf": {"engine": "mistral-ocr"}}],
    }
    response = requests.post(API, headers=HEADERS, json=body, timeout=300)
    response.raise_for_status()
    data = response.json()
    parts = data["choices"][0]["message"]["annotations"][0]["file"]["content"]
    texts = [p["text"] for p in parts if p.get("type") == "text"]  # skip extracted image parts
    text = "\n".join(t for t in texts if not t.startswith(("<file", "</file")))
    return html.unescape(text), data["usage"]["cost"]

blocks.text: Turning scanned documents into reliable text is hard. Classic OCR engines such as Tesseract fail on faded print, handwriting and faxes. Vision models read those pages well, but sometimes write values that aren’t on the page. We made eight test pages from text we wrote, so every character could be checked, and ran them through 15 vision models and Mistral OCR on OpenRouter, plus Tesseract.

blocks.text: We rendered each page from known text, then degraded it like a scan: a small rotation, blur, noise and JPEG compression. Five pages are ordinary: a receipt, a letter with two deliberate misspellings, a form with a ticked box, a two-column newsletter and a neat handwritten note. Three are built to be hard: a faded thermal receipt, fast cramped handwriting, and a low-resolution fax of 12 serial numbers made from look-alike characters (0/O, 1/I/L, 5/S, 8/B), so a model can’t guess them from context.

import base64
import mimetypes
import os

import requests

API = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions"
HEADERS = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY']}"}
PROMPT = ("Transcribe all of the text in this scanned document, in reading order. "
          "Copy spelling, numbers and punctuation exactly as they appear, even if they "
          "look wrong. Return plain text only, with no Markdown and no commentary.")


def transcribe(path, model="deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash", reasoning={"effort": "none"}):
    mime = mimetypes.guess_type(path)[0] or "image/jpeg"
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        image = f"data:{mime};base64," + base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode()
    body = {
        "model": model,
        "max_tokens": 16000,
        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": [
            {"type": "text", "text": PROMPT},
            {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": image}},
        ]}],
    }
    if reasoning:
        body["reasoning"] = reasoning
    response = requests.post(API, headers=HEADERS, json=body, timeout=300)
    response.raise_for_status()
    data = response.json()
    choice = data["choices"][0]
    if choice["finish_reason"] != "stop":
        raise ValueError(f"finish_reason={choice['finish_reason']}: the transcript is incomplete")
    return choice["message"]["content"], data["usage"]["cost"]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    text, cost = transcribe("receipt.jpg")
    print(text)
    print(f"\n${cost:.5f}")

import base64
import html
import io
import os

import requests
from PIL import Image, ImageSequence

from transcribe import API, HEADERS  # from step 1


def mistral_ocr(path):
    if path.lower().endswith(".pdf"):  # scanned PDFs go as they are
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            raw = f.read()
    else:  # wrap an image in a PDF in memory, one page per frame of a multipage TIFF
        pages = [p.convert("RGB") for p in ImageSequence.Iterator(Image.open(path))]
        buf = io.BytesIO()
        pages[0].save(buf, "PDF", save_all=True, append_images=pages[1:])
        raw = buf.getvalue()
    pdf = "data:application/pdf;base64," + base64.b64encode(raw).decode()
    pdf_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(path))[0] + ".pdf"
    body = {
        "model": "upstage/solar-mini4",  # any cheap text model; it only has to reply
        "max_tokens": 5,
        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": [
            {"type": "text", "text": "Reply OK."},
            {"type": "file", "file": {"filename": pdf_name, "file_data": pdf}},
        ]}],
        "plugins": [{"id": "file-parser", "pdf": {"engine": "mistral-ocr"}}],
    }
    response = requests.post(API, headers=HEADERS, json=body, timeout=300)
    response.raise_for_status()
    data = response.json()
    parts = data["choices"][0]["message"]["annotations"][0]["file"]["content"]
    texts = [p["text"] for p in parts if p.get("type") == "text"]  # skip extracted image parts
    text = "\n".join(t for t in texts if not t.startswith(("<file", "</file")))
    return html.unescape(text), data["usage"]["cost"]
